Subject: MAP draft + evaluation milestones (SparkHealth)

Hi Daniel —

Thanks again for the time last week. Per our call, attached is a first-draft Mutual Action Plan for the 60-day evaluation you described. High-level items inside:
- Success criteria (throughput targets, latency SLOs, quality checks on NER/clinical extraction)
- Milestones (kickoff, model calibration, load test, executive review)
- Pilot credits and expendables (initial 150k tokens + 25k streaming tokens reserved)
- Proposed conversion pricing and commit tiers so you can budget for production if MAP milestones are met

Couple of asks from our side:
1) Please confirm the throughput profile (avg tokens/session and peak concurrent sessions) so we can size the dedicated pool for the load test.
2) Let us know who on procurement should receive the SOW and quote — I cc'd Marissa who will own contractual follow-up.

I've attached MAP_SparkHealth_v2.pdf and a provisional pricing_matrix.xlsx so you can see what conversion tiers look like once you convert. If the mid-tier commit is acceptable we can offer a ramp credit and a one-time onboarding support package.

Next step: if you can sign off on the milestones this week we can start the onboarding and provision test capacity by 02/16.

Thanks,

Karthik —

Thanks for the draft. A few notes from my side:
- The evaluation window looks good, but our procurement team will need a formal SOW + quote to start internal approval. Can you send an itemized SOW and the expected billing cadence?
- We want to test a production-like load; can you confirm you can provision the same GPU profile you plan for production for the load test?
- Regarding credits: the initial allocation is helpful but our execs want a longer runway — can we get an extra 40k tokens earmarked for ramp testing?
- For conversion pricing: we need a firm 6-month commit price and a signal on discounts if we increase commit after month 3.

Looping in procurement so they can flag any contract issues early. If you can get the SOW and a revised MAP with the additional credit by Thursday we can try to keep the kickoff timeline.

FYI: Daniel asked for an extra 40k tokens and a firm 6-month commit price with a tiered discount after month 3. Procurement is looped. Proposed concessions below:
- Extend pilot credits by +40k tokens (one-time non-recoupable add)
- Offer 10% onboarding credit for first month if they sign 6-month commit within 30 days of MAP completion
- Conversion pricing: base rate $0.0035/token for first 6 months on a $50k/mo commit; if they increase to $75k/mo within month 3, drop to $0.0028/token thereafter (retroactive to increase date)
- Provide identical GPU profile for load test (NVIDIA H100-equivalent) for two full test days

Approval needed: can we offer the token extension + the temporary discount structure? Also need sign-off on the retroactive discount language (finance will need to review). If approved I will send updated MAP and DocuSign package to Daniel.

Subject: Re: MAP: Evaluation plan & conversion terms (SparkHealth) — updated and next steps

Daniel —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Per our internal review we can make the following commitments:

1) Credits & runway
- We will extend the evaluation credits by 40k tokens (non-recoupable). Total pilot allocation now 190k tokens + 25k streaming tokens.

2) Test environment
- We will provision a production-matched GPU profile for the load test (2 days) and provide an operations runbook to reproduce performance tests.

3) Conversion pricing & ramp
- Firm 6-month commit pricing: $0.0035/token on a $50k/month commit.
- If SparkHealth increases to $75k/month within the first 90 days after conversion, we will apply a reduced rate of $0.0028/token going forward and credit the difference pro rata to the date of increase.

4) Onboarding credit
- If SparkHealth signs the 6-month commit within 30 days after MAP sign-off, offer a one-time 10% onboarding credit applied to the first invoice.

5) SOW & signatures
- I've attached the SOW (SOW_SparkHealth_draft.docx) and the finalized MAP (MAP_SparkHealth_v2.pdf). DocuSign Link: https://docusign.com/txn/ABC123-SH-MAP

Proposed timeline:
- 02/19: MAP + SOW signed (DocuSign)
- 02/22: Onboarding kickoff and provisioning
- 03/31: Evaluation window ends, executive review week of 04/06
- 04/15: Target conversion effective date if milestones met

If that all looks reasonable, please countersign the DocuSign package and I'll schedule onboarding. Happy to hop on a call this week to go through the MAP line-by-line if you want — propose Thursday 02/19 at 10am PT.

Regards,
Karthik
